class.name: RoadVehicleServer
class.brief_description: Where a road vehicle is, and how it drives.
class.description: Which road of [RoadServer]'s network a vehicle is on, how far along it, which way it travels, the way it takes on - one of the roads at random where they part, chosen as far ahead as it looks - and how fast what is ahead lets it go: the velocity it wants, the roads' limits, the vehicle ahead in its lane, a dead end. A vehicle on a road laid along a track is reported on that track as well ([TrackServer]). The vehicle itself - its handle, name, commands - is [VehicleServer]'s; this server takes a vehicle created there ([method vehicle_attach]) whose controller is a [RoadVehicleController], and steps all of them in one loop as their implementation, registered with [VehicleServer] as [code]road[/code]. No couplers, no cabs, no trainsets. Two vehicles on one road pass each other when they are beside each other - their places across the road ([method RoadVehicleController.get_side_offset]) further apart than half their widths together.

method.name: vehicle_attach
method.description: A [VehicleServer] vehicle becomes a road vehicle - called by whatever makes it one. A vehicle freed by [VehicleServer] is detached on its own.

method.name: vehicle_detach
method.description: The vehicle is a road vehicle no more; it leaves the track it was on.

method.name: vehicle_get_road
method.description: The road the vehicle is on; an invalid RID before it is put on one.

method.name: vehicle_get_transform
method.description: Where the vehicle stands: on the road's curve at its place across the road, its front (-Z) the way it travels.

method.name: vehicle_is_attached
method.description: Whether [param vehicle] is a road vehicle of this server.

method.name: vehicle_set_road
method.description: The vehicle stands [param offset] metres from the road's start, kept within the road, its front toward [param facing]; announced as [signal vehicle_placed].

method.name: vehicle_trace_route
method.description: The tracks ahead of the vehicle as far as [param distance] metres, the one it is on first ([method TrackServer.track_trace_route]).

signal.name: vehicle_placed
signal.description: The vehicle stands on a road now - it was put there ([method vehicle_set_road]).

signal.name: vehicle_placement_changed
signal.description: The vehicle is somewhere else on its road - once a step it moved in; what draws it follows.
